title: Leveling
text: So we made our way through the grasslands and headed to a nearby village.
“You know, yesterday… I could barely manage to fight a weak monster called a ‘balloon.’ What should I do?”
“Father, you basically can’t fight without allies.”
“Yeah. I know that. But how am I supposed to get any allies? No one will join me because of the rape allegations, and this country hates the Shield Hero, doesn’t it?”
Hmm… Come to think of it, my Father used to have a Big Sister who was his right-hand woman. I think she was a slave, actually… What should we do?
“Well… you should just buy some slaves and make them fight!”
“Slaves!?”
Father’s face was filled with shock.
“S-slaves actually exist in this world…? Well, they’re a familiar sight in games and fantasy stories, I suppose.”
“If you work them like workhorses, their levels will go up, too.”
“No… I can’t make them do something that cruel.”
“Oh? That’s odd. I’m pretty sure Father used to command a large number of slaves.”
“What kind of monster am I in the future!?”
“I was teaching the slaves to defeat monsters with smiles on their faces.”

I remember him boasting about something like that. Still, even though that village smelled like pigs, it was a wonderful place that was very livable. The slaves were working with smiles on their faces, too.
“That’s awful! I can’t do something so crazy!”

My Father looked flustered. So he was actually this kind of gentle person all along. He’d been battered by the rough waves of the world, and on top of that, he’d been deceived—that’s why he’d become so embittered. I want to protect this innocent face.
“Wait—why is my future self doing something so terrible?”
“It’s a painful truth for you, Father, but I’m actually the one who should be in Itsuki’s position.”
“Huh…? What do you mean?”
“I, too, was completely deceived by the Crimson Swine and had come to believe that you were the one who did it.”
“I-I see… that’s how it was…”
“I’m truly sorry! This is the greatest stain on Motoyasu’s life. If you say I should take my own life, I’ll die right here and now.”
“No… Motoyasu, you were deceived too, weren’t you? Well, then, it can’t be helped. You believe me now, after all.”
Those were words I was deeply grateful for. I bowed my head in gratitude for Father’s compassion, which ran deeper than the ocean.
“So, why did I enslave people?”
“Presumably, because you had no allies and no one you could trust, your pent-up frustration came to the surface, leading you to the idea of overworking a slave.”
“I see… It’s true—if I really had no allies, that might have happened.”
“But this time is different! I absolutely trust you, Father.”
It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say I practically worship him. After all, he’s Filo-tan’s father and my savior.
“Thanks. But slaves are a bit…”
“Well, I suppose there’s no helping it then. Kuro-chan.”
“Pii?”
“From now on, I’m going to rush Kuro-chan’s training. Once Kuro-chan is fully trained, he’ll train my Father in the same way.”
“Pii!”
“Ah, I see. So the idea is that once Kuro-chan is trained, he can join me as a party member. Since Motoyasu-kun is strong, we can power-level together.”
“Exactly! First, we’ll level Kuro-chan up to around 30, and then Kuro-chan will help my Father.”

In the meantime, I’ll look for work at the guild… or hunt down thieves who look like they’re worth some money. The more funds I have to get Filo-tan, the better. Furthermore, Filolial-sama is a national treasure. We must increase their numbers as much as possible. That is my, Motoyasu’s, lifelong goal.
“So, what should I be doing?”
“Well then… Father, why don’t you just enjoy a leisurely tea time?”
“Why does it have to be like that?!”
“But there’s no way I could possibly give you orders, Father.”
“Hmm… Alright. I’ll see if I can figure out something to do on my own.”
“Well then, let’s go! We’re meeting up in this village tonight.”
“Yeah, got it.”
“Pee!”

After saying goodbye to my Father, Kuro-chan and I hurried off, racing through the mountain range where powerful monsters roam. Since I already have a high-level bonus, and the return trip will take just a moment using a portal, I’ll level up Kuro-chan as fast as possible. The only problem is food, but that shouldn’t be an issue if we feed on the monsters we defeat. After all, Filolial-sama is the strongest angel who eats just about anything. With that in mind, I crossed the mountain range and entered the area inhabited by powerful monsters… specifically, dragon-type creatures.
“Brionac! Hahahaha! Weak! Way too weak!”

I used my Skills nonstop to mow down the dragons inhabiting the mountain range and the monsters of their bloodline one after another. Dragons are Filolial-sama’s natural enemy! Which means they’re also Motoyasu’s natural enemy! I’ll advance with the determination to exterminate every last one of them.

I guess they finally realized they were no match for me—after fighting for a while, the dragons stopped coming near me. But that’s none of my concern. It’ll be a while before Ren and Itsuki come to this hunting ground. It’s not like there aren’t places where stronger monsters appear, but within a day’s travel, this was the only option! I can’t wait to see just how strong I can make my Father in the month leading up to the Wave—I’m raring to go!

Fighting like that until dusk, Kuro-chan’s level shot up to 32. I’d secured plenty of food, and I’d gathered a ton of materials too. There was so much that it was a hassle to carry it all back, and the loot drops were massive. I’ll have to share some with my Father later. So, I used a portal to return to the village where I’d arranged to meet my Father.
“Welcome back, Motoyasu-kun. How big is Kuro-chan now?”
“Piyo?”
“Whoa. You’ve gotten bigger, haven’t you?”

Kuro-chan, who has evolved from Filolial-sama’s chick into her next form, is following me around. She’s about the size of my thigh and has a round, bun-like body. She’ll probably grow into her normal Filolial form by tomorrow. I’ve prepared plenty of food for Kuro-chan, so there’s no problem.
“Piyo…”
Poor thing—his stomach is constantly growling. I’ll have to prepare a meal for him right away.
“Mmm… You’re so cute, Kuro-chan!”
“Piyooooo!”
When I rubbed him, Kuro-chan narrowed his eyes happily. Filolial-sama really is the world’s greatest treasure. I can’t help but scoff at the idea that such a rough-and-tumble dragon could be a Rival.
“That’s right. He’s growing so fast. So? What level has he reached?”
“He’s already at 32.”
“That fast!? I thought Motoyasu-kun said you could only raise him to level 40?”
“Yes. After that, you’ll need to do a Class Up.”
“But… isn’t the Dragon Hourglass managed by the government? After getting into such a fight with the government officials, won’t we be unable to do that?”
“No problem at all. If we go to another country, they’ll surely let us use an hourglass.”
“Ah, so it’s not just Melromarc… Well then, first we need to get strong enough to travel to the neighboring country.”
“Hahaha, we’ve got a lot to do tomorrow!”
“Yeah. Oh, right, Motoyasu. I was wondering if there was anything I could do to help, so I tried fishing in the river.”

With that, my father showed me the fish he’d caught. He must be good at fishing—he caught quite a lot. He said he’d set some aside for Kuro-chan’s meal. Even though his expressions and mannerisms are different, Father is still very much himself. Come to think of it, Filo-tan really loved Father’s cooking. I’m sure Kuro-chan will like it, too.
“Well then, let’s cook this at the inn.”
“Oh, can I do it? It’s about the only thing I’m good at.”
“Hahaha, your cooking is exquisite, Father. I’m really looking forward to it.”
“It’s not like I’m that good at it—nothing to brag about… but is that a story from the future?”
“Yes, everyone loved your cooking.”
“Is that so? Well, I’ll do my best then.”

And so, Father borrowed the kitchen from the inn staff (the owner was reluctant, so I had to threaten him a bit) and cooked for us. That said, the flavor wasn’t quite as good as my future Father’s. It was probably due to his Shield skill. Even so, it was exquisite. It’s the ultimate flavor that I could never recreate here in Motoyasu.
“Wow, that was absolutely delicious.”
“It was nothing special. I tried borrowing some seasonings, but this really is another world, isn’t it? Aside from salt, the taste just feels a little different.”
“As expected of you, Father—you’re so humble. Well then, Kuro-chan and I will be sleeping in the stable. You, Father, should lock your door securely and sleep in your room.”
“Motoyasu, you’re going to sleep in the stable? Shouldn’t I be the one sleeping there, since I’m the one who borrowed the money?”
“Hahaha, I can’t very well let Kuro-chan sleep in an inn room. It can’t be helped.”
“I see… Well then, I’ll leave all my valuables with you, Motoyasu. I’d hate for them to get stolen while I’m asleep.”
With that, Father handed me the money and the armor. This is a sign of trust. It’s time to prove my loyalty!
“I intend to protect the items entrusted to me by Father with my very life!”
“P-please do.”
“In return, you should put the materials I brought into your shield.”
I handed my Father the various materials I’d brought as souvenirs and had him incorporate them into his weapon. His level probably isn’t high enough yet, but they’ll surely come in handy later.
“W-wow, that’s amazing. Though, it says my level and conditions aren’t high enough…”
“That can’t be helped. You should gather materials little by little and put them into the shield.”
“Like what?”

“You can turn anything into a material—stones, grass, branches, you name it. My future Father used to dismember the monsters he defeated, turning them into bones and meat, and put them into his shield.”
“Dismember, huh. So you don’t just put them in as-is; you can process them into other materials too. I see… The system is actually pretty detailed. Yeah, anyway, I’ll give it my best shot.”
“I think Kuro-chan will be able to fight as Father’s bodyguard by tomorrow, so we’ll be kicking off our activities in earnest.”
“Yeah.”
“Piyo!”

And so, we ended up resting at the inn. Kuro-chan kept complaining of hunger even at night, eating the food we’d brought back each time. And as I listened to the sounds of Kuro-chan growing and sniffed her scent, I had a dream in which I was reunited with Filo-tan.
